span.normalized: Accounting for the agreements with GM requires management to make judgments in determining that no portion of the investment proceeds by GM were attributable to the Offtake Agreements, which management concluded contained a market pricing structure. The Company’s assessment was informed by a competitive process for the investment and offtake agreements on a combined basis.
